description: A playful blue cake featuring a bold red car topper, colourful star decorations, white clouds and a multicoloured border. The bright design and cheerful details create a fun themed cake, especially suited to a child-focused celebration.

name: Teddy Bear Cloud Cake
description: A blue celebration cake decorated with soft cloud-shaped details, golden stars, a teddy bear, a small ladder and personalised lettering. The gentle colour palette and playful teddy bear theme create a charming design for a baby or child-focused celebration.

name: YouTube Theme Cake
description: A bold red and white celebration cake inspired by YouTube, featuring the recognisable play-button design, chocolate pieces, chocolate-covered treats and personalised lettering. The detailed arrangement creates a distinctive themed cake for a content creator or milestone celebration.

name: Teddy Bear 12 Birthday Cake
description: A cheerful pink birthday cake featuring a teddy bear topper, colourful cake pops, star decorations, floral details and a prominent number 12. The playful arrangement combines a milestone number with bright decorative elements for a lively birthday celebration.

name: Teddy Bear Number 12 Cake
description: A celebration cake featuring a prominent number 12 topper, two playful teddy bear figures, pink bunting and colourful floral details. The combination of the number and teddy bear elements creates a cheerful design for a birthday celebration.

name: Unicorn 10th Birthday Cake
description: A pastel birthday cake featuring a colourful unicorn design, floral accents, macarons and a prominent number 10. The soft rainbow-inspired colours and unicorn theme create a cheerful design for celebrating a milestone birthday.

name: Angry Birds Red Character Cake
description: A red-and-white cake decorated with the recognisable face of the red Angry Birds character, including large eyes, bold eyebrows and an orange beak. The strong colours and simple character design make it a distinctive themed cake for fans of the game.

name: Golden Number 1 Cake
description: A celebration cake decorated in white and gold with a large number 1 topper, golden balloons, pearl accents and delicate piped details. The prominent number 1 gives the design a clear first-birthday identity with an elegant celebratory finish.

name: Couple Character Cake
description: A beige cake featuring two illustrated characters leaning toward each other with small red hearts above them. The simple design and affectionate character artwork give it a cute, romantic look suited to celebrating a couple or a special moment together.

name: Blue Bow Designer Cake
description: A white cake decorated with a light blue centre panel, piped blue and white borders, and a delicate bow-inspired design. Its soft colours and traditional decorative finish create a neat, elegant look for a range of celebrations.

name: Pastel Rainbow Drip Cake
description: A colourful cake featuring pastel horizontal bands, white drip detailing, small red heart accents and a generous arrangement of multicoloured piped swirls on top. The bright palette and layered finish create a playful design for a cheerful celebration.

name: Teddy Bear Half Birthday Cake
description: A playful pink-and-white cake decorated with teddy bear figures, colourful flowers, a crown topper, hearts and a prominent half-birthday number design. The cheerful character details make it a charming choice for a little one’s birthday celebration.

name: Red Rose Heart Cake
description: A heart-shaped cake decorated with red hearts, a large red rose, green leaves, red ribbon detailing and piped borders. The romantic floral design creates a classic centrepiece for celebrating love and special moments.

name: Pink Heart Rose Cake
description: A pink-and-white cake decorated with pink and white piped swirls, a heart-shaped centre detail and brushstroke-style pink accents around the sides. The floral-inspired finish gives it a soft, romantic appearance suitable for celebrating someone special.

name: Pink Butterfly Cake
description: A soft pink ombré cake decorated with purple butterfly toppers and a fine gold border along the top edge. The butterflies add movement and contrast to the simple finish, creating an elegant design for a special celebration.

name: Dinosaur Theme Cake
description: A colourful cake featuring a large green dinosaur design, a blue-and-green background, yellow flowers, red accents and piped greenery. The playful dinosaur artwork and bright outdoor-inspired details make it a fun choice for a children’s celebration.

name: Hello Kitty Pink Cake
description: A pink cake featuring a Hello Kitty character design on top, bright pink piped borders, flower decorations and pearl-like accents around the sides. The familiar character and coordinated pink detailing make it a cheerful choice for a themed celebration.
